ex.en: I have coffee, tea, water, and fresh fruit juice.
ex.zh: 我有咖啡、茶、水跟新鮮果汁。

ex.en: My brother bought two bottles of orange juice.
ex.zh: 我哥哥買了兩瓶柳橙汁。

ex.en: Would you all like to drink fruit juice or water?
ex.zh: 各位想喝果汁還是水？

juice.en: the liquid that comes from fruit or vegetables

ex.en: This battery is about to run out of juice.
ex.zh: 這電池快要沒電了。

ex.en: My phone is running out of juice.
ex.zh: 我的手機快沒電了。

juice.en: electric power, especially the power left in a battery

ex.en: Tom has accumulated a lot of junk.
ex.zh: 湯姆囤積了一大堆廢物。

ex.en: Tom has no idea what to do with all the junk in his garage.
ex.zh: 湯姆不知道該怎麼處理車庫裡那堆雜物。

junk.en: old things that have no value and are no longer wanted

ex.en: Tom used to eat a lot of junk food.
ex.zh: 湯姆以前常吃很多垃圾食物。

ex.en: I don't eat junk food.
ex.zh: 我不吃垃圾食物。

junk.en: food that is quick to eat but not good for your health

ex.en: I throw away junk mail without reading it.
ex.zh: 垃圾郵件我看都不看就丟掉。

ex.en: My inbox is full of junk mail.
ex.zh: 我的收件匣塞滿了垃圾郵件。

junk.en: unwanted advertising letters or emails sent to many people

ex.en: She is a junior accountant at the firm.
ex.zh: 她是這家公司的初級會計。

ex.en: All junior staff must attend the training.
ex.zh: 所有資淺員工都必須參加訓練。

junior.en: lower in rank or position than others in a job

junior.zh: 年紀較小的（be junior to sb）

ex.en: Jimmy is junior to me by two years.
ex.zh: 吉米比我小兩歲。

ex.en: She is five years junior to me.
ex.zh: 她比我小五歲。

ex.en: My brother is a junior in college.
ex.zh: 我哥哥是大三學生。

ex.en: As a junior, she started looking for internships.
ex.zh: 她大三時就開始找實習機會。

junior.en: a student in the third year of a four-year school course

ex.en: The case is under judicial review.
ex.zh: 這個案子正在接受司法審查。

ex.en: We trust the judicial system.
ex.zh: 我們信任司法制度。

judicial.en: relating to courts, judges and the law

ex.en: There is no justification for such behavior.
ex.zh: 這種行為沒有任何正當理由。

ex.en: What is the justification for this extra cost?
ex.zh: 這筆額外費用的理由是什麼？

justification.en: a good reason that shows something is right or fair

ex.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
ex.zh: 他剛發表了一系列有趣的文章。

ex.en: He cannot be hungry; he has just had lunch.
ex.zh: 他剛吃完午餐，不可能會餓。

ex.en: You were just listening to the talk, without thinking.
ex.zh: 你只是在聽講，沒有思考。

ex.en: It's just a small problem.
ex.zh: 這只是個小問題。

ex.en: We were just talking about you when you called.
ex.zh: 你打電話來的時候，我們正好在聊你。

ex.en: That's just what I needed.
ex.zh: 那正是我需要的。

just.en: at exactly that moment or in exactly that way

ex.en: The judge made a just decision.
ex.zh: 法官做出了公正的判決。

ex.en: We all want a just and fair system.
ex.zh: 我們都希望有一個公正公平的制度。

ex.en: Judging from her appearance, I think that she's rich.
ex.zh: 從她的外表看來，我想她很有錢。

ex.en: Don't judge a man from the way he looks.
ex.zh: 不要以貌取人。

ex.en: He can't be very wealthy, judging from his salary.
ex.zh: 從他的薪水來看，他不可能很有錢。

judge.en: to form an opinion about someone or something after thinking carefully

ex.en: The judge listened carefully to both sides.
ex.zh: 法官仔細聽取了雙方的說法。

ex.en: She was one of the judges at the singing contest.
ex.zh: 她是那場歌唱比賽的評審之一。

judge.en: a person who decides legal cases in court or chooses the winner in a contest

ex.en: It is dangerous to jump onto a moving train.
ex.zh: 跳上行駛中的火車很危險。

ex.en: Hearing the news, he jumped out of his chair.
ex.zh: 他一聽到消息就從椅子上跳了起來。

ex.en: He could not help jumping for joy at the good news.
ex.zh: 他聽到好消息，忍不住高興得跳了起來。

jump.en: to push yourself off the ground into the air

ex.en: Sales jumped by 20 percent last quarter.
ex.zh: 上一季銷售額暴增了 20%。

ex.en: Oil prices jumped overnight.
ex.zh: 油價一夜之間大漲。

jump.en: to rise suddenly by a large amount

ex.en: Don't jump to conclusions before you hear the facts.
ex.zh: 還沒了解事實之前，先別急著下結論。

ex.en: Let's not jump to conclusions.
ex.zh: 我們先別妄下結論。

jump.en: to decide something too quickly without knowing all the facts

ex.en: I've always trusted your judgment.
ex.zh: 我一直都相信你的判斷。

ex.en: Use your best judgment.
ex.zh: 請自行做出最好的判斷。

ex.en: In my judgment, the plan is too risky.
ex.zh: 依我看，這個計畫風險太高。

judgment.en: the ability to make good decisions, or an opinion about something

ex.en: The court will give its judgment next week.
ex.zh: 法院將在下週宣判。

ex.en: The judge passed judgment on the case.
ex.zh: 法官對這起案件做出了判決。

judgment.en: an official decision made by a court

ex.en: Justice will prevail in the end.
ex.zh: 正義終將勝利。

ex.en: I fight in the cause of justice.
ex.zh: 我為正義而戰。

ex.en: The objective of law is justice.
ex.zh: 法律的目標是正義。

justice.en: fair treatment of people according to what is right

ex.en: He believes the justice system should be reformed.
ex.zh: 他認為司法制度應該改革。

ex.en: The Ministry of Justice announced new rules.
ex.zh: 法務部宣布了新規定。

justice.en: the system of courts and laws that punishes wrongdoing

ex.en: The end justifies the means.
ex.zh: 為了目的可以不擇手段。

ex.en: How can you justify spending so much money?
ex.zh: 你要怎麼解釋花這麼多錢的理由？

ex.en: The results justified the cost.
ex.zh: 這些成果證明這筆花費是值得的。

justify.en: to show or explain that something is right or reasonable

ex.en: The jury's guilty verdict gave rise to widespread debate.
ex.zh: 陪審團的有罪判決引起了廣泛的爭論。

ex.en: The jury looked shocked.
ex.zh: 陪審團看起來很震驚。

jury.en: a group of ordinary people who decide if someone is guilty in a court case

ex.en: The jury chose her design as the winner.
ex.zh: 評審團選出她的設計為優勝作品。

ex.en: He served on the jury of the film festival.
ex.zh: 他擔任那屆影展的評審。

jury.en: a group of people who choose the winner of a competition

ex.en: The lion is the king of the jungle.
ex.zh: 獅子是叢林之王。

ex.en: He wrote a book about a jungle adventure.
ex.zh: 他寫了一本關於叢林冒險的書。

ex.en: The children got lost in the jungle.
ex.zh: 孩子們在叢林裡迷路了。

jungle.en: a thick forest in a hot, wet part of the world

jungle.zh: （比喻）競爭激烈的地方；雜亂的一堆

ex.en: Looking down, we saw a concrete jungle.
ex.zh: 我們往下看，是一片水泥叢林。

ex.en: The business world can be a jungle.
ex.zh: 商場可能是弱肉強食的叢林。

jungle.en: a place that is very competitive or a confusing mess of things

ex.en: Juvenile crimes have been increasing recently.
ex.zh: 少年犯罪最近一直在增長。

ex.en: The court handles juvenile cases separately.
ex.zh: 法院將未成年人的案件分開審理。

juvenile.en: relating to young people who are not yet adults

ex.en: Stop making juvenile jokes in the meeting.
ex.zh: 別再在會議上開幼稚的玩笑了。

ex.en: His juvenile behavior annoyed his coworkers.
ex.zh: 他孩子氣的行為讓同事們很煩。

juvenile.en: silly and not mature, like a child

ex.en: This case is outside the court's jurisdiction.
ex.zh: 這個案子不在這個法院的管轄範圍內。

ex.en: Each city has jurisdiction over its own parks.
ex.zh: 各城市管轄自己的公園。

jurisdiction.en: the official power to make legal decisions, or the area where that power applies

ex.en: I trust her judgement on this matter.
ex.zh: 在這件事上我信任她的判斷。

ex.en: It was a mistake in judgement to leave so late.
ex.zh: 這麼晚才出發是判斷上的失誤。

ex.en: The court will give its judgement next week.
ex.zh: 法院將在下週宣判。

ex.en: The judge's judgement surprised everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 法官的判決讓在場所有人都感到驚訝。

ex.en: Turn left at the next junction.
ex.zh: 在下一個路口左轉。

ex.en: There is a petrol station near the junction.
ex.zh: 路口附近有一間加油站。

ex.en: The two rivers meet at a junction near the town.
ex.zh: 兩條河在鎮附近的匯流處會合。

ex.en: Each juror listened carefully to the witness.
ex.zh: 每位陪審員都仔細聆聽證人的證詞。

ex.en: She was chosen as a juror in a long trial.
ex.zh: 她被選為一場冗長審判的陪審員。

ex.en: School finishes in June, and summer vacation begins.
ex.zh: 學校六月結束，暑假就開始了。

ex.en: They plan to get married next June.
ex.zh: 他們打算明年六月結婚。

ex.en: The weather in June is hot and humid.
ex.zh: 六月的天氣又熱又潮濕。

ex.en: Summer vacation starts in July.
ex.zh: 暑假從七月開始。

ex.en: It is very hot and sunny in July.
ex.zh: 七月又熱又晴朗。

ex.en: We are going to the beach on the fifth of July.
ex.zh: 我們七月五日要去海邊。

ex.en: Julia is a popular girl's name in many countries.
ex.zh: 朱莉婭在許多國家都是受歡迎的女孩名字。

ex.en: The name Julia comes from Latin.
ex.zh: 朱莉婭這個名字源自拉丁文。

ex.en: Julie is a French form of the name Julia.
ex.zh: 朱莉是 Julia 這個名字的法文形式。

ex.en: Julie waved to her friends from the train window.
ex.zh: 朱莉從火車窗戶向朋友們揮手。

juliet.zh: 朱麗葉（莎士比亞劇作《羅密歐與朱麗葉》的女主角）

ex.en: Juliet is the female lead in Shakespeare's play Romeo and Juliet.
ex.zh: 朱麗葉是莎士比亞劇作《羅密歐與朱麗葉》的女主角。

ex.en: Our class read the balcony scene with Juliet and Romeo.
ex.zh: 我們班讀了朱麗葉與羅密歐的陽台那一幕。

ex.en: Julius is a name that comes from ancient Rome.
ex.zh: Julius 是源自古羅馬的名字。

ex.en: Julius is sitting at the back of the classroom.
ex.zh: 朱利葉斯坐在教室後面。

ex.en: She pulled a warm woolen jumper over her head.
ex.zh: 她套上一件溫暖的羊毛衫。

ex.en: I bought my son a blue jumper for winter.
ex.zh: 我給兒子買了一件藍色套頭毛衣過冬。

ex.en: The high jumper cleared the bar on her first try.
ex.zh: 那位跳高選手第一次就越過了橫桿。

ex.en: Horses used as jumpers need years of training.
ex.zh: 用於跳躍項目的馬需要多年的訓練。

ex.en: She poured milk from a glass jug.
ex.zh: 她從一個玻璃壺裡倒出牛奶。

ex.en: Please fill the jug with water for the table.
ex.zh: 請把水壺裝滿水放到桌上。

ex.en: Judaism is one of the oldest religions in the world.
ex.zh: 猶太教是世界上最古老的宗教之一。

ex.en: She is writing a paper on the history of Judaism.
ex.zh: 她正在寫一篇關於猶太教歷史的報告。

ex.en: The peaches were sweet and juicy.
ex.zh: 這些桃子又甜又多汁。

ex.en: He bit into a juicy burger.
ex.zh: 他咬了一口多汁的漢堡。

ex.en: She loves telling juicy stories about her coworkers.
ex.zh: 她很愛說同事們的精彩八卦。

ex.en: The magazine is full of juicy gossip.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌滿是勁爆的八卦。

ex.en: The town held a big jubilee to celebrate its fiftieth anniversary.
ex.zh: 小鎮舉辦了盛大的慶典來慶祝建鎮五十週年。

ex.en: People danced in the streets during the jubilee.
ex.zh: 慶典期間，人們在街上跳舞。

ex.en: The judiciary must remain independent from the government.
ex.zh: 司法機關必須與政府保持獨立。

ex.en: She has worked in the judiciary for over twenty years.
ex.zh: 她在司法體系工作超過二十年。

ex.en: The country has a strong judiciary system.
ex.zh: 這個國家有健全的司法體系。

ex.en: Judiciary reform was discussed at the conference.
ex.zh: 會議上討論了司法改革。

ex.en: The clown can juggle five balls at once.
ex.zh: 那個小丑可以同時拋接五顆球。

ex.en: He learned to juggle oranges at the street fair.
ex.zh: 他在街頭市集學會了拋接橘子。

ex.en: She has to juggle work and taking care of her kids.
ex.zh: 她得同時兼顧工作和照顧孩子。

ex.en: Many students juggle classes with part-time jobs.
ex.zh: 許多學生要同時兼顧課業和打工。

ex.en: There was a jumble of shoes by the door.
ex.zh: 門邊散亂地堆著一堆鞋子。

ex.en: His notes were a jumble of words and drawings.
ex.zh: 他的筆記是文字與塗鴉混雜的一團。

ex.en: Don't jumble the papers; I've sorted them already.
ex.zh: 別把這些文件弄亂，我已經整理好了。

ex.en: The puzzle pieces got jumbled together in the box.
ex.zh: 拼圖片在盒子裡全混在一起了。
